meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'everything', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Я знаю всё в моём отеле.
examples.trans: I know everything in my hotel.

meanings.en: dwarf, gnome (mythological creature or mocking word for a short person)
meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'dwarf, gnome' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Who's a dwarf? I'm a dwarf?
Seven dwarfs lived in the fairy tale.
Listen here, you dwarf! Go away from here.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.

+ instrumental. Core Russian prep meaning 'for; behind' in everyday speech.

Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'ткнуться'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to shut up'. The reflexive suffix '-ся'/'-сь' makes the action intransitive, reciprocal, or directed at the subject.

examples.text: Заткнись, Вика, я никогда не делаю ошибок!
examples.trans: Shut up, Vika, I never make mistakes!

examples.text: Заткнись, рыжая, не мешай мне спокойно работать!
examples.trans: Shut up, redhead, do not disturb me working peacefully!

meanings.note: Чн is pronounced шн. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: Agreeing, often reluctantly. Core Russian part meaning 'all right, OK' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: All right, here you go. There, look.

набрать.gloss: to gather, rack up (views/points); to dial

meanings.en: to gather, collect, rack up (views, points)
meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'брать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to gather, rack up (views/points); to dial', paired with 'набирать'.

Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'брать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to gather, rack up (views/points); to dial', paired with 'набирать'.

examples.text: Ролик уже набрал четыре миллиона просмотров!
examples.trans: The clip has already got four million views!

examples.text: Мы наберём много лайков в интернете.
examples.trans: We will gather many likes on the internet.

meanings.note: Parenthetical adverb. Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'верное').

examples.trans: Well, probably somewhere in the archive.
He has probably already come home.

examples.text: Наверное, что-то серьёзное у вас. Девочка уже две недели лежит в областной клинике!
examples.trans: It must be something serious for you. The girl has been lying in the regional clinic for two weeks already!

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence
Ну, папа!. Core Russian part meaning 'well; come on' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

обниматься.gloss: to hug each other, to embrace

meanings.en: to hug, to embrace each other
meanings.note: Reciprocal reflexive verb. Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ниматься'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to hug each other, to embrace', paired with 'обняться'.

examples.text: Что вы обнимаетесь? Вы с ума сошли!
examples.trans: Why are you two hugging? Have you lost your minds!

examples.text: Да, под такую музыку обниматься немного неловко.
examples.trans: Yes, it is a bit awkward hugging to such music.

meanings.note: domestic animal, or foolish person in colloquial use

examples.trans: A white sheep is grazing in the field.
You are a foolish sheep yourself, got it?

meanings.note: On foot. Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to go (set off)', paired with 'идти'.

examples.trans: Can I go and have a look?

meanings.en: to be quiet, to keep silent for a bit
meanings.note: politer or softer than молчать in commands

examples.trans: Let's be quiet for a moment.

examples.text: Помолчите, пожалуйста. Не видите, человеку плохо?
examples.trans: Please be quiet. Can't you see someone isn't feeling well?

meanings.note: Понял? = got it?; понял = got it. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'нять'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to understand', paired with 'понимать'.

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'терять'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to lose', paired with 'терять'.

examples.text: Что смотрите, бандерлоги? Вы совсем страх потеряли?
examples.trans: What are you staring at, you monkeys? Have you lost all fear?

meanings.note: Это правильно = that's right. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Это правильно. Я приглашаю вас в общественный совет.
examples.trans: That's right. I'm inviting you onto the public council.

придумать.gloss: to think up, to come up with

meanings.en: to think up, to invent, to come up with
meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'думать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to think up, to come up with', paired with 'придумывать'.

examples.trans: You came up with this yourself!

examples.text: Как нет? Ты же сам это всё придумал!
examples.trans: What do you mean, no time? You came up with all this yourself!

meanings.note: regularly, or as a general invitation: приходи!

examples.trans: If you change your mind, come back. The job is waiting.

meanings.note: 'сейчас буду' = I'll be right there
Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ейчас').

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?

examples.trans: Keep an eye on the child.
